b_tech_first_year.eligibility: Passed 10+2 / HSC Examination with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects along with one of Chemistry/Biotechnology/Biology/Technical Vocational subject/Computer Science/IT, securing at least 45% marks (40% for backward class categories, EWS, and PwD candidates of Maharashtra State). Valid non-zero score in MHT-CET (Maharashtra) or JEE (Main) Paper I.
b_tech_first_year.admission_process: Admissions are conducted through the Centralized Admission Process (CAP) rounds administered by the State Common Entrance Test Cell, Government of Maharashtra (cetcell.mahacet.org). Institutional Level seats and seats vacant after CAP rounds are filled as per State CET Cell guidelines.

b_tech_direct_second_year.eligibility: Passed Diploma in Engineering and Technology with at least 45% marks (40% for reserved categories of Maharashtra) OR Passed B.Sc. Degree from a recognized university with at least 45% marks and Mathematics at 10+2 level.
b_tech_direct_second_year.admission_process: Through Centralized Admission Process (CAP) conducted by Maharashtra State CET Cell.

mba.eligibility: Passed minimum 3-year Bachelor's Degree in any discipline with at least 50% marks (45% for reserved category candidates of Maharashtra) and a valid non-zero score in MAH-MBA-CET, CAT, CMAT, MAT, XAT, or ATMA.
mba.admission_process: Through CAP rounds conducted by State CET Cell Maharashtra, and Institute Level Quota.

bca_and_bba.course_name: Bachelor of Computer Application (BCA) & Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA)
bca_and_bba.eligibility: Passed 10+2 / HSC from a recognized board with minimum required percentage and valid score in MAH-B.BCA/BBA/BMS/BBM-CET conducted by State CET Cell.
bca_and_bba.admission_process: Through State CET Cell CAP registration and institute reporting.

mca.eligibility: Passed BCA or Bachelor Degree in Computer Science Engineering or equivalent, or passed B.Sc./B.Com./B.A. with Mathematics at 10+2 or graduation level with at least 50% marks (45% for reserved category). Valid score in MAH-MCA-CET.
mca.admission_process: Through Maharashtra State CET Cell CAP rounds.

m_tech.eligibility: Passed Bachelor's Degree in relevant field of Engineering and Technology from AICTE approved institution with at least 50% marks (45% for reserved category) with valid GATE score or sponsored candidate criteria.
m_tech.admission_process: Through DTE/State CET Cell CAP counseling rounds.

required_documents: CAP Allotment Letter & Seat Acceptance Confirmation
MHT-CET / JEE Main / MAH-CET Score Card
Diploma / Graduation Marksheets (for DSE / PG candidates)
Migration Certificate (if applicable for other than Maharashtra State Board/University)
Nationality Certificate and Domicile Certificate of Maharashtra
Caste Validity Certificate (Mandatory for reserved categories)
Non-Creamy Layer Certificate valid up to 31st March of current financial year (for OBC/VJNT/SBC)
Income Certificate issued by competent authority (Tahsildar)
EWS Eligibility Certificate (if applying under EWS quota)
Minority Affidavit / Certificate (for Religious Minority candidates - Jain)
Passport size recent color photographs (5 copies)
Aadhaar Card copy & Bank Account details (linked with Aadhaar)
